kpis.name: Feedstock Moisture (Average)
kpis.description: Average moisture content of received biomass feedstock. High moisture reduces gasifier thermal efficiency and increases drying energy demand.
kpis.formula: Average of all moisture analyses received per batch

kpis.name: Feedstock Ash Content
kpis.description: Ash content of received biomass on a dry basis. High ash causes slagging, fouling, and increased solids disposal cost in the gasifier.
kpis.formula: Weight of ash residue / dry weight of sample × 100

kpis.name: Feedstock Contract Coverage
kpis.description: Percentage of annual feedstock requirement covered by signed off-take or supply agreements.
kpis.formula: (Tonnage under contract / Annual requirement) × 100

kpis.name: Feedstock Cost Variance
kpis.description: Variance of actual feedstock delivered cost against budgeted cost, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.formula: |(Actual cost - Budget cost) / Budget cost| × 100

kpis.name: Feedstock Availability Onsite
kpis.description: Days of feedstock storage available onsite based on current stockpile and daily consumption rate.
kpis.formula: Current stockpile tonnage / Average daily consumption rate

kpis.name: Feedstock Higher Heating Value (HHV)
kpis.description: Higher heating value of received biomass on a dry basis, indicating energy content per unit mass.
kpis.formula: Measured by bomb calorimeter per ASTM D5865

kpis.name: Gasifier Availability
kpis.description: Percentage of scheduled operating time that the gasifier is actually available to produce syngas.
kpis.formula: (Operating hours / Scheduled hours) × 100

kpis.name: Gasifier Cold Gas Efficiency
kpis.description: Ratio of chemical energy in the product syngas to chemical energy in the feedstock, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.formula: (Syngas HHV × Syngas flow) / (Feedstock HHV × Feedstock feed rate) × 100

kpis.name: Carbon Conversion
kpis.description: Fraction of feedstock carbon converted to gaseous products in the gasifier.
kpis.formula: (Carbon in syngas / Carbon in feedstock) × 100

kpis.name: Syngas H2/CO Ratio
kpis.description: Molar ratio of hydrogen to carbon monoxide in the cleaned syngas delivered to the FT reactor.
kpis.formula: Mole fraction H2 / Mole fraction CO (on dry basis)

kpis.name: Syngas Tar Concentration After Cleanup
kpis.description: Total tar concentration in syngas downstream of the tar reformer / scrubber train.
kpis.formula: Gravimetric or GC-FID tar measurement per standard method

kpis.name: Sulfur Breakthrough in Guard Bed Outlet
kpis.description: Concentration of sulfur species (H2S + COS) measured at the exit of the sulfur guard bed, immediately upstream of the FT reactor.
kpis.formula: Measured by online GC or analyser with ppb-level detection

kpis.name: Chlorine Breakthrough in Guard Bed Outlet
kpis.description: Concentration of chlorine species (HCl) measured at the exit of the chloride guard bed, immediately upstream of the FT reactor.
kpis.formula: Measured by online analyser or impinger sampling with IC detection

kpis.name: FT CO Conversion Per Pass
kpis.description: Fraction of carbon monoxide converted to hydrocarbon products in a single pass through the FT reactor.
kpis.formula: ((CO_in - CO_out) / CO_in) × 100
kpis.source: DCS / gas analyser on reactor inlet and outlet

kpis.name: FT C5+ Selectivity
kpis.description: Selectivity of the FT reactor towards C5+ hydrocarbon products (liquids and waxes), excluding methane and LPG-range gases.
kpis.formula: (Carbon in C5+ products / Total carbon converted) × 100

kpis.name: FT Catalyst Productivity
kpis.description: Mass of total hydrocarbons produced per unit mass of catalyst per hour.
kpis.formula: Total hydrocarbon production rate / Catalyst weight in reactor

kpis.name: FT CH4 Selectivity
kpis.description: Selectivity of the FT reactor towards methane, which represents an undesirable by-product that consumes hydrogen without producing liquid fuels.
kpis.formula: (Carbon in CH4 / Total carbon converted) × 100

kpis.name: Hydrocracker Jet Yield
kpis.description: Yield of jet-range hydrocarbons produced from hydrocracking of FT wax, expressed as a percentage of wax feed.
kpis.formula: (Jet product flow / Wax feed flow to hydrocracker) × 100

kpis.name: Hydrocracker H2 Consumption
kpis.description: Hydrogen consumption per tonne of feed processed in the hydrocracker unit.
kpis.formula: Total H2 consumed (make-up + recycle net) / Total feed processed

kpis.name: Jet Fraction Yield of FT Products
kpis.description: Overall yield of the jet (SAF) fraction as a percentage of total FT liquid products, including hydrocracked wax.
kpis.formula: (Jet fraction production / Total FT liquid product) × 100

kpis.name: SAF Product Quality Pass Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of SAF batch samples that meet all ASTM D7566 Annex A2 (FT-SPK) specification tests on first attempt.
kpis.formula: (Passed batches / Total batches tested) × 100

kpis.name: ASTM D7566 FT-SPK Qualification Progress
kpis.description: Progress towards full ASTM D7566 Annex A2 qualification testing for FT-SPK, including all required property tests and any blend testing.
kpis.formula: (Completed qualification items / Total qualification items) × 100

kpis.name: Sustainability Certification Progress
kpis.description: Progress towards achieving a recognised sustainability certification (e.g., ISCC, RSB) for the SAF production pathway.
kpis.formula: (Completed certification milestones / Total milestones) × 100

kpis.name: Carbon Intensity
kpis.description: Lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions of the produced SAF per unit of energy, calculated according to the relevant certification scheme methodology.
kpis.formula: Total lifecycle GHG emissions / Total fuel energy output

kpis.name: Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
kpis.description: Ratio of earned schedule to planned schedule, measuring whether the project is on schedule.
kpis.formula: Earned Progress (physical % complete) / Planned Progress (planned % complete)

kpis.name: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
kpis.description: Ratio of earned value to actual cost, measuring whether the project is on budget.
kpis.formula: Earned Value / Actual Cost

kpis.name: Procurement Progress
kpis.description: Percentage of major procurement packages that have been awarded (contract signed) against the total planned packages.
kpis.formula: (Packages awarded / Total planned packages) × 100

kpis.name: HAZOP Recommendation Close-Out Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of HAZOP / process safety study recommendations that have been closed out (implemented or formally managed) versus total recommendations raised.
kpis.formula: (Closed recommendations / Total recommendations) × 100

kpis.name: Commissioning Readiness
kpis.description: Percentage of pre-commissioning and commissioning systems that have passed their pre-start-up safety review and system handover checks.
kpis.formula: (Systems passed / Total systems to commission) × 100

kpis.name: Safety Incident Rate
kpis.description: Total recordable safety incidents (injuries, illnesses, and lost-time events) per 200,000 hours worked.
kpis.formula: (Recordable incidents × 200,000) / Total hours worked

kpis.name: Offtake Readiness
kpis.description: Percentage of planned offtake agreements for SAF (and co-products) that have been signed or are in final negotiation stage.
kpis.formula: (Signed offtake volume / Planned offtake volume) × 100

kpis.name: Blending Logistics Readiness
kpis.description: Percentage of the physical blending and logistics chain (truck/rail offloading, storage, blending equipment, pipeline injection, certification paperwork) that is confirmed operational.
kpis.formula: (Confirmed logistics links / Total logistics links) × 100
